questions.q: A mocap bridge sends VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE with the exact capture time in the usec field; the full pipeline delay is 120 ms and VISO_DELAY_MS = 10. What will ArduPilot 4.6 do?
options: Subtract the 120 ms itself by comparing the usec stamp with its own clock
Fuse the measurement as if it were taken about 10 ms ago
Drop packets older than 100 ms
Fall back to the compass and barometer
questions.explain: The usec field is used only to remove jitter (JitterCorrection): the fastest packet is assumed to arrive with zero delay. Only VISO_DELAY_MS sets the constant delay; the remaining 110 ms produce a lag of v·Δτ and phase lag in the position loop.

questions.q: Which EKF3 source set matches flying on optical flow with a rangefinder and no GPS?
options: POSXY 5, VELXY 5, POSZ 2, VELZ 5, YAW 6
POSXY 6, VELXY 0, POSZ 6, YAW 6
POSXY 0, VELXY 5, POSZ 1 or 2, YAW 1
POSXY 4, VELXY 0, POSZ 4 or 1, YAW 1
questions.explain: Flow is a velocity-only source (VELXY = 5); POSXY has no value 5. The set with sixes is ExternalNav, the one with fours is beacons.

questions.q: The EKF uses external navigation, there is no GPS, and arming in Loiter returns "PreArm: AHRS: waiting for home". What is missing?
options: Compass calibration and magnetic declination from the coordinates
The EKF origin: SET_GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN
A VISION_SPEED_ESTIMATE message
ARMING_SKIPCHK = −1 (before 4.7, ARMING_CHECK = 0)
questions.explain: Without GPS nothing sets the lat/lon origin, and without it there is no home. The GCS or the bridge sets the origin once; a second time gives "EKF3: origin already set".

questions.q: A log fragment from a hover on external navigation. What happened, and what did the bridge fail to do?
options: The source delay grew by 2 s; the bridge did not update VISO_DELAY_MS and the timestamps
The source shifted the pose by 2 m in a jump; the bridge did not increment reset_counter
The barometer failed; the bridge did not send altitude
The X and Y axes are swapped; the bridge did not convert ENU to NED
questions.explain: VISP.PX steps by +2 m, the innovation is −2 m, SP > 1, so the measurements are rejected, and Rst stayed at 0. After 2 s the EKF accepted the new pose and the vehicle flew off to "correct" the error. With reset_counter the EKF would have moved the position at once, and the controller would have shifted the target.

questions.q: EK3_FLOW_MAX = 2.5 rad/s, flying on flow alone at a height of 2 m. What ground speed limit will the EKF impose?
options: 3 m/s
5 m/s
7 m/s
questions.explain: ekfGndSpdLimit = (EK3_FLOW_MAX − 1) · h = 1.5 · 2 = 3 m/s: 1 rad/s is reserved for body rotation. Before 4.7 the parameter was called EK3_MAX_FLOW.

questions.q: In the lab, with X/Y swapped, the vehicle flew off by hundreds of meters. Why did the EKF not save it?
options: The position innovation gate was disabled by EK3_POS_I_GATE = 0
The EKF rejected the measurements, but after 7 s without position it reset to the source
External navigation does not go through the innovation check
The compass overrode the heading and hid the error
questions.explain: SP was 5–7, so the measurements were rejected, but on the position timeout (posRetryTimeNoVel_ms = 7000) the EKF resets to the only source. Wrong axes are caught only by the hand check before takeoff.

questions.q: Which limitation of beacons (BCN_TYPE) in ArduPilot 4.6 is correct?
options: No more than 4 anchors, a compass is required
Mocap is needed to calibrate the anchors
They work only with EKF2
Heading comes from the beacons, so the compass is disabled
questions.explain: AP_BEACON_MAX_BEACONS = 4; EKF3 starts fusing ranges only after yaw alignment, and beacons give no heading, so EK3_SRC1_YAW = 1.

questions.q: An ODOMETRY message with frame_id = MAV_FRAME_LOCAL_NED and child_frame_id = MAV_FRAME_BODY_FRD reaches ArduPilot 4.6 with VISO_TYPE = 1. The result?
options: Position is accepted, velocity is ignored
The message is silently dropped
Position is automatically converted to FRD
The EKF switches to the SRC2 set
questions.explain: handle_odometry accepts only the MAV_FRAME_LOCAL_FRD / MAV_FRAME_BODY_FRD pair and simply returns on anything else: there will be no VISP in the log, and pre-arm will say "VisOdom: not healthy".
